title: Plans and pricing, effective 1 March 2026
text: This price list applies to all new and renewing subscriptions from 1 March 2026 and replaces the price list dated 1 February 2024. All prices are in US dollars per seat and exclude sales tax, VAT or GST, which is added based on the billing country. Free costs $0 and allows up to 5 members in one workspace. Team costs $10 per seat per month on monthly billing, or $8 per seat per month billed annually, which is $96 per seat per year. Team requires a minimum of 3 seats. Business costs $19 per seat per month on monthly billing, or $16 per seat per month billed annually, which is $192 per seat per year, with a minimum of 5 seats. Enterprise is priced by quote, is billed annually only, and requires at least 50 seats. Customers who were on 2024 prices keep them until their first renewal on or after 1 June 2026, after which the new prices apply. Switching from monthly to annual billing can be done at any time and takes effect immediately, with the unused part of the current month credited. Switching from annual to monthly billing is only possible at the annual renewal date. Charges are made in US dollars only; card issuers may add their own foreign transaction fees, which are not refunded.

title: Plans and pricing, effective 1 February 2024 (superseded)
text: Status: superseded on 1 March 2026 by the current price list. This page is kept for reference because workspaces that subscribed before 1 March 2026 keep these prices until their first renewal on or after 1 June 2026. Under this price list, Free allowed up to 10 members in one workspace and 5 GB of total storage. Team cost $9 per seat per month on monthly billing, or $7 per seat per month billed annually, with a minimum of 2 seats. Business cost $17 per seat per month on monthly billing, or $14 per seat per month billed annually, with a minimum of 3 seats. Enterprise was priced by quote with a minimum of 25 seats and could be billed monthly or annually. Sales tax, VAT or GST was added on top based on the billing country, as it is today. Annual billing could be switched to monthly billing at any time, with the difference credited to the account. The 2024 price list also included a Starter add-on for single users at $4 per month, which was withdrawn when this list was superseded; existing Starter users were moved to Free with their data kept.

title: Plan limits: storage, file size, automations and boards
text: Storage is pooled across the workspace. Free workspaces get 2 GB in total, Team gets 10 GB per paid seat, Business gets 50 GB per paid seat, and Enterprise storage is unlimited subject to fair use. The maximum size of a single uploaded file is 25 MB on Free, 250 MB on Team, 1 GB on Business and 5 GB on Enterprise; larger files are rejected at upload and should be shared as a link instead. An automation run is counted each time an automation rule completes its actions, so a rule with three actions still counts as one run. Monthly allowances are 100 runs on Free, 2,000 runs on Team, 25,000 runs on Business and 250,000 runs on Enterprise, shared by the whole workspace. Allowances reset at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each calendar month, not on the billing date, and unused runs do not roll over. When the allowance is used up, automations pause until the reset; there is no overage charge. Team and Business workspaces can buy a top-up pack of 5,000 extra runs for $15, valid until the end of the calendar month. Free workspaces are limited to 3 active boards; paid plans have no board limit. Version history for docs is kept for 7 days on Free, 90 days on Team, and indefinitely on Business and Enterprise.

title: Roles, guests and guest billing
text: Every workspace has one primary owner, plus admins, members and guests. Team workspaces are limited to 3 admins; Business and Enterprise have no admin limit. Members are billed seats. Guests are people outside your organisation who are invited to specific projects only; they cannot see the member directory, create projects or join the workspace as a whole. Guest allowances are 2 guests on Free, 1 guest per paid seat on Team, and 5 guests per paid seat on Business; Enterprise has no guest cap. Guest access is free only at viewer or commenter level. A guest who is given editor permission on any project is billed as a full member seat from the next billing cycle, at the same per seat price as other members, and appears on the invoice as a guest editor. Changing the guest back to viewer before the cycle ends avoids the charge. Guest invitations expire after 7 days if they are not accepted, and guests who have not signed in for 90 days are removed from the workspace automatically, although their comments and uploads stay. On Business, only owners and admins can invite guests; on Team, any member can invite guests unless an admin turns this off.

title: Seat billing, proration and invoices
text: Each member in a paid workspace uses one seat. Seats added during a billing period are charged immediately, prorated by the day for the time left in the current monthly or annual period. On monthly billing, seats can be removed at any time, but the lower seat count takes effect at the next monthly renewal and no credit is given for the current month. On annual billing, the number of paid seats can only be reduced at the annual renewal date; removing a member before then frees the seat for someone else to use but does not reduce the charge or produce a refund. Invoices are issued on the renewal date and are paid by credit or debit card. Business workspaces on annual billing and all Enterprise workspaces can pay by bank transfer on 30-day terms. If a card payment fails, the charge is retried 1, 3 and 7 days later, and owners are emailed each time. If an invoice is still unpaid 14 days after the first failed attempt, the workspace becomes read-only until payment is made; nothing is deleted. Tax IDs such as a VAT or GST number can be added in billing settings and appear on future invoices only; past invoices are not reissued.

title: Changing plans: upgrades and downgrades
text: Upgrades take effect immediately, and the price difference for the rest of the billing period is charged straight away, prorated by the day. Downgrades also take effect immediately at the moment they are confirmed, not at the end of the current billing period, so the workspace loses the higher plan's features right away. The unused value of the higher plan for the rest of the period is not refunded to the card; it is added to the workspace as account credit, which is applied automatically to future invoices and expires 12 months after it is issued. If the workspace is over the limits of the new plan, nothing is deleted: boards, files and automations beyond the new limits become read-only or paused until usage is brought under the limit or the workspace upgrades again. Downgrading from Business to Team removes single sign-on, so members who signed in only through SSO must set a password; they are emailed a link that is valid for 72 hours. Owners can downgrade only once in any 30-day period. A downgrade to Free is treated as a cancellation of the paid subscription and follows the cancellation and retention rules.

title: Refund policy
text: Monthly subscriptions are not refunded for partial months, whether the workspace is cancelled, downgraded or has members removed. Annual subscriptions can be refunded in full if the owner asks within 14 days of the annual charge; this applies to the first annual purchase and to each automatic annual renewal. After 14 days, annual subscriptions are not refunded, but cancelling stops the next renewal and the workspace keeps its plan until the end of the paid term. Duplicate charges caused by a payment error are refunded in full, whatever the timing, within 5 business days of being reported. Refunds always go back to the original payment method and are issued within 10 business days; how long they take to appear on a statement depends on the card issuer. Automation top-up packs, unused account credit and charges for guest editors are not refundable. Refund requests must come from the workspace owner or a billing admin, through the billing page or a support ticket. If an owner files a card chargeback instead of a refund request, the workspace is set to read-only while the dispute is open. Reminder emails are sent 7 days before every annual renewal.

title: Business plan free trial
text: Any workspace on Free or Team can start one 14-day trial of the Business plan. No credit card is needed to start the trial. Each workspace can trial Business only once, and one extension of 7 days can be granted by the sales team on request. During the trial all Business features are available, except that the automation allowance is limited to 2,500 runs and storage is limited to 20 GB in total. When a trial started from Free ends, the workspace does not drop back to the Free plan automatically. Instead it becomes read-only for 30 days: everyone can view and export content, but nobody can create or edit anything until an owner chooses a paid plan or switches to Free by hand. Switching to Free is only possible once the workspace meets the Free limits, so members beyond 5 and boards beyond 3 must be removed or archived first. If nothing is chosen within the 30 days, the workspace stays read-only; nothing is deleted. A Team workspace that trials Business returns to Team automatically at the end of the trial and keeps its Team billing. Owners are emailed 3 days and 1 day before the trial ends.

title: Workspace deletion, data export and retention
text: Only the primary owner can delete a workspace. On Team, Business and Enterprise, a deleted workspace can be restored within 14 days by the owner through a support ticket; after 14 days it is purged. On the Free plan there is no recovery window: a deleted Free workspace is permanently deleted immediately and cannot be restored by support. Items deleted from boards go to the trash and stay there for 30 days on Free and 90 days on paid plans. When a paid subscription is cancelled, the workspace moves to Free at the end of the paid term; content over the Free limits is kept read-only for 180 days, after which the oldest files over the 2 GB storage limit are deleted first. Closed user accounts are deactivated for 30 days, during which the person can sign back in to reopen them, and are then erased. Backups containing deleted data are overwritten within 35 days. Data export: owners and admins on paid plans can export the whole workspace, including boards, tasks, docs, comments and attachments, as a JSON archive from the admin console. On Free, export is only available one board at a time as a CSV file, without attachments. Export links are emailed and expire after 72 hours, and exports over 10 GB are split into parts.

title: Two-factor authentication, SSO and sign-in security
text: Two-factor authentication (2FA) can use an authenticator app or a hardware security key; codes by SMS are not supported. When 2FA is turned on, the user receives 10 single-use backup codes. Admins on Business and Enterprise can require 2FA for every member. Support staff cannot remove, disable or bypass 2FA on any account, even after identity checks. A member who loses their 2FA device must sign in with a backup code or ask a workspace owner or admin to reset their 2FA from the admin console. If the primary owner loses both their device and their backup codes and there is no other admin, recovery requires proving control of the company email domain by adding a DNS TXT record, and takes up to 5 business days. After 5 failed password attempts in a row, sign-in is locked for 15 minutes; a further 5 failures lock the account until the password is reset by email. SAML single sign-on is available on Business and Enterprise, and SCIM user provisioning is on Enterprise only. Enterprise admins can set session timeouts between 1 hour and 30 days; on other plans, sessions last 14 days.

title: Public API: access, rate limits and tokens
text: The REST API is available on Team, Business and Enterprise; Free workspaces have no API access. Rate limits are 100 requests per minute on Team, 300 requests per minute on Business and 1,000 requests per minute on Enterprise. Limits apply per workspace, not per token: every personal token, service token and connected integration in the workspace shares the same allowance, so creating another token does not add capacity. Requests over the limit receive an HTTP 429 response with a Retry-After header. If a token keeps sending requests over the limit for more than 10 minutes, it is suspended for 1 hour. Personal tokens expire after 90 days unless renewed; service tokens, available on Business and Enterprise, do not expire but must be tied to an admin. Each user can hold up to 25 active tokens. Webhooks are retried 5 times over 24 hours if the receiving endpoint does not return a success status, and are disabled after 3 consecutive days of failures. Bulk endpoints accept up to 100 items per request and count as a single request against the limit.

title: Uptime SLA, service credits and maintenance windows
text: Business and Enterprise subscriptions include an uptime commitment of 99.9 percent per calendar month; Free and Team have no SLA and no service credits. If monthly uptime falls below 99.9 percent, the credit is 10 percent of that month's subscription fee; below 99.0 percent it is 25 percent; below 95.0 percent it is 50 percent, which is the maximum. Credits are not applied automatically: the owner or a billing admin must request them through a support ticket within 30 days after the end of the affected month. Credits are applied to the next invoice and are never paid out as cash or refunded to a card. Downtime does not count if it is caused by scheduled maintenance, by a third-party integration, or by the customer's own network. Scheduled maintenance takes place on Sundays between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC, is announced at least 72 hours ahead on the status page, and is limited to 4 hours a month. During maintenance, boards stay readable but edits and notifications may be delayed by up to 15 minutes. Uptime is measured by external checks every minute from three regions.

title: Support channels and hours by plan
text: Free workspaces get the help centre and community forum only; email tickets from Free workspaces are answered only for billing and account access issues. Team workspaces get email support Monday to Friday, 8 am to 8 pm UTC, with a first response within 24 business hours; there is no weekend support on Team. Business workspaces get email and live chat 24 hours a day, Monday to Friday, with a first response within 8 business hours. Enterprise workspaces get round-the-clock phone, chat and email for Severity 1 issues, meaning the service is down or data is at risk, with a first response within 1 hour, and a first response within 4 business hours for everything else; each Enterprise workspace also has a named customer success manager. Support is in English on all plans, with Spanish, German and Japanese available on Business and Enterprise during local business hours. Support does not cover building custom API integrations or writing automations for customers. Public holidays do not change these hours, except 25 December and 1 January, when only Severity 1 Enterprise support is available.

title: Education discount
text: Accredited schools, colleges and universities get 50 percent off the Business plan. The education discount applies to annual billing only and cannot be combined with other offers. Verification needs an institutional email domain and proof of accreditation, and takes up to 5 business days. Teachers and students using a personal workspace for coursework can use the Team plan free for up to 10 seats, renewed every 12 months by verifying again. If the discount is granted after purchase, it applies from the next renewal and is not backdated. Commercial arms of universities, private tutoring businesses and training companies are not eligible. The discount covers up to 500 seats in one workspace; seats beyond that are charged at the standard annual price. The education discount does not apply to Enterprise or to automation top-up packs. Separate rules, with a different discount rate and billing options, apply to registered nonprofits.

title: Nonprofit discount
text: Registered nonprofits and charities get 30 percent off the Team and Business plans, on either monthly or annual billing. Verification needs a registration certificate from the country's charity or nonprofit regulator and takes up to 10 business days. The nonprofit discount does not apply to Enterprise or to automation top-up packs, and political parties, government bodies and organisations whose main activity is religious worship are not eligible. The discount covers up to 200 seats in one workspace; seats beyond that are charged at the standard price. It is applied from the date of approval, and charges made before approval are not refunded. Eligibility must be verified again every 24 months, and the discount ends at the next renewal if it is not. The nonprofit discount cannot be combined with the education discount; an organisation that qualifies for both gets the education discount if it bills annually.
